# Rules audit (generated by `python3 tools/rules_audit.py`; edit verdicts in `docs/rules-audit-verdicts.json`)

**rules audit 2026-10-16: 242 items, confirmed 81, house 48, conflict 2, open 111.** Sources and versions: `docs/manual-notes.md` (top table). Verdicts: **confirmed** = official page/section cited; **house** = no official text, kept; **conflict** = the source says otherwise (R3 fix, one patch each); **open** = no source cited yet.
Auto verdicts trust the citation written next to the rule; a cited English VER.17.0 page can still lag the Japanese 17.1 text.
